scope: One character, shared across all three tiers
xpFormulaNote: 2026-10-18: 240 -> 2000 (total play time to Lv40 must stay 42h or more; with 240 a daily 30-minute run cut it to 30~36h). modelXp values below are from the 240 design.
autoHunt: Starts on entry; manual movement/attack stops it; HUD restarts it
timer: Wall-clock while entered; explicit leave/death preserves unused time; no offline XP
online: Server-authorized timer, idempotent run/kill reports, bounded kill credits, dedicated XP ledger, no field loot or quest-kill credit

models.note: Model only; actual XP is paid for real kills and capped at Lv.40.
